# RoutePostAttribute

Kind: Class  
Namespace: `Sisk.Core.Routing`  
Assembly: `Sisk.Core.dll`  
Source: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Routing.RoutePostAttribute.html

Represents a mapping to an HTTP POST route. This attribute is an shorthand from [RouteAttribute](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Routing.RouteAttribute.md).

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method, AllowMultiple = true, Inherited = true)]
public sealed class RoutePostAttribute : RouteAttribute
```
